lines: Every day, trains drive 75 meters below the sea.
The Channel Tunnel runs 38 kilometers under the sea. No tunnel on Earth has a longer undersea section.
At its deepest, it runs 75 meters below sea level.
And it's actually three tunnels. Two for trains, and one in the middle for service.
Digging started in 1987. The tunnelers met under the sea in 1990, and it opened in 1994.
Follow for a new megaproject every day.
